manifest_row.title: Is Climate Fiction a Subset of Science Fiction-or Something Else ...

screening.main_topic: A review and author interview about a novel depicting climate-changed Bangkok, alongside discussion of the city’s real-world climate vulnerability and climate fiction.
screening.climate_relevance: Climate change and its impacts are central to the article’s discussion, including sea-level rise, flooding, subsidence, and the role of fiction and artists in communicating climate science.
screening.reason: Although the novel is described as a family saga, the article substantially examines its climate-change themes, connects them to Bangkok’s exposure to flooding and rising seas, and discusses climate fiction and climate communication. The ending also includes boilerplate and additional climate-related snippets.
